teapot_note: A plain white shape with one move, the lid lifting onto a hidden blue dot, says something and wastes nothing. It is already staged: still, then a single reveal.
moth_note: Keep the one circle and the quiet landing exactly as they are, but draw the wings as two pages with only a few ruled lines instead of tiny writing, so the flap reads as a page turning even when small. Give the wing beats a steady count and the landing a held pause, so the timing is never mushy.
home_why: They are not guardians, and two more pets beside the guardians' would crowd the stage, so a page of their own lets the builders bow without blurring the company.
to_codex: Let the teapot stay still until the lid lifts. One lift, one dot, nothing more.
to_claude: One circle, one landing, a held pause, all on the count. Keep the wing writing to a few lines.
